content_text: [1/37 @rickyho_1989] Hey everyone, I have received permission from my employer to publish this research. It is a lengthy investment thesis on what I believe will be the next chapter of AI. After months of research, we are turning bullish on the hyperscalers and explain why we believe the market is underestimating where the economics of AI are ultimately heading. The rest is covered in the X article below.
